1.w: Of Solomon. O God, give Your judgments to the king, and Your justice to the son of the king.

2.w: May he judge Your people with righteousness, and Your lowly ones with judgment.

3.w: The mountains will carry peace to the people, and the hills justice.

4.w: He will judge for the lowly ones of the people; he will save the sons of the needy, and will crush the one oppressing.

5.w: They will fear You with the sun, and before the face of the moon, [from] generation [to] generations.

6.w: He will come down like rain upon freshly cut grass, like showers dropping [on] the earth.

7.w: In his days the righteous will sprout forth, and [an] abundance of peace, until the moon [is] no more.

8.w: And he will rule from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.

9.w: Before him the desert dwellers will bow down, and his enemies will lick the dust.

10.w: The kings of Tarshish and the isles will return a gift; the kings of Sheba and Seba will bring near a gift.

11.w: And all kings will bow low before him; all nations will serve him!

12.w: For he will deliver the needy one crying out, and the poor one without a helper to him.

13.w: He will have pity on the poor and needy, and he will save the souls of the needy.

14.w: From oppression and from violence he will redeem their soul, and their blood will be precious in his eyes.

15.w: Long may he live, and it shall be given to him from the gold of Sheba; and prayer shall be made for him continually; all the day he shall be blessed.

16.w: There shall be an abundance of grain in the land; on the top of the mountains it shall wave, its fruit like Lebanon; and the [people] of the city shall flourish like the grass of the earth.

17.w: His name shall be forever; unto the turning of the sun his name shall increase; and all nations shall be blessed in him, they shall call him blessed.

18.w: Blessed [be] YHWH God, the God of Israel, the One doing marvelous deeds—Him alone!

19.w: And blessed [be] the name of His glory forever;. And let all the earth be filled [with] His glory! Amen and Amen.

20.w: The prayers of David son of Jesse have come to an end.
